title.narrative: Inclusive food system transformation in Central Mali

description.narrative: Project Objective: Improving the livelihoods of young people by strengthening centralised and resilient value chains in the food systems of the Ségou, Mopti and Bandiagara regions.

The project contributes to transforming local food system in central Mali and create opportunities for the youth to develop their social, professional and economical skills. This will include the identification of local food systems strengths and shortcomings in order to improve the resilience of the system in a context prone to disaster and conflicts, enriched with several innovative approaches such as the development of a FoodLab, the dissemination of climate-resilient and agroecological cultivation methods, or strengthened contractual relationships in an informal business environment. This will be combined with the AA project working around several strategic axes to ensure nexus approach and transitional development. Focus on social cohesion, inclusion and governance components.

The target group is comprised of 259,770 direct participants (early warning system, mitigation plans, microprojects, infrastructure); at least 18,750 agro-pastoralists; 750 young dynamic entrepreneurs; and around 820 people through various committees and platforms (including government representatives). The degree of overlap between participant groups is determined at the start-up phase.
